mapper.insert: insert into `order` (order_no, user_id, total_amount, pay_type, status, address, receiver_name, receiver_phone) values (#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{totalAmount}, #{payType}, #{status}, #{address}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone})
mapper.select: SELECT MAX(order_no) FROM `order` WHERE order_no LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%')
select o.*, lg.status as logistics_status from `order` o left join logistics lg on lg.order_id = o.id where o.user_id = #{userId} order by o.create_time desc

select distinct o.*, lg.status as logistics_status from `order` o inner join order_item oi on oi.order_id = o.id inner join product p on p.id = oi.product_id inner join merchant m on m.id = p.merchant_id left join logistics lg on lg.order_id = o.id -- 物流status where m.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY o.create_time DESC

select distinct o.* -- 查出订单的所有信息（去重，避免重复） from `order` o -- 从订单主表查 inner join order_item oi -- 关联订单明细表（知道买了啥） on oi.order_id = o.id -- 订单ID = 明细的订单ID inner join product p -- 关联商品表 on p.id = oi.product_id -- 商品ID = 明细里的商品ID inner join merchant m -- 关联商家表 on m.id = p.merchant_id -- 商家ID = 商品所属商家 where o.order_no = #{orderNo} -- 按订单号查 and m.user_id = #{userId} -- 关键：只查属于【当前商家】的订单 limit 1

select distinct o.* from `order` o inner join order_item oi on oi.order_id = o.id inner join product p on p.id = oi.product_id inner join merchant m on m.id = p.merchant_id where o.id = #{orderId} and m.user_id = #{userId} limit 1
